SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "regions.name"
  FROM regions AS regions
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
), _cm_regions__customers__orders__iif_order_date_2025_01_01_an_c3b813cd_1_01_1_0_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS "orders.iif_order_date_2025_01_01_an_c3b813cd_1_01_1_0_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_regions__customers__orders__id_count AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(orders.id) AS "orders.id_count"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."regions.name",
  _cm_regions__customers__orders__iif_order_date_2025_01_01_an_c3b813cd_1_01_1_0_sum."orders.iif_order_date_2025_01_01_an_c3b813cd_1_01_1_0_sum" AS "regions.orders_2025",
  COALESCE(_cm_regions__customers__orders__id_count."orders.id_count", 0) AS "regions.all_orders"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_regions__customers__orders__iif_order_date_2025_01_01_an_c3b813cd_1_01_1_0_sum
  ON _base."regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_regions__customers__orders__iif_order_date_2025_01_01_an_c3b813cd_1_01_1_0_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_regions__customers__orders__id_count
  ON _base."regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_regions__customers__orders__id_count."orders.customers.regions.name"
ORDER BY
  _base."regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21
